title: Khet Sathi field file: site/data/fields/<id>.json
description: Output contract between the pipeline and the site, from CLAUDE.md 'The output contract'. Never rename or remove a key without updating this file and noting it in the step summary. Checks JSON Schema cannot express (ordering, uniqueness, cross-references, array lengths) live in pipeline/export/validate.py.

water_source.description: The field's water source (config/fields/<id>.yaml; 'unknown' while it is not known). replay.<plan>[].harvest, dry_days and event are the field's own case: rain-fed for 'unknown' and 'rain-only'. While it is 'unknown', show the two cases side by side: 'if you can't water' (harvest, dry_days) and 'if you can water' (irrigated). Owner, 2026-11-12.

status_date.description: Build step 8 (2026-11-14): the day of the field twin's soil water behind every section's status and wetness (the latest day with weather). Show 'as of <date>'.

shift_days.description: Monsoon-onset trend over the record, days (Sen's slope x (years - 1)). Negative = earlier. Since 2026-11-14 (owner) from DHM's official onset dates (diary.shift_source), not from satellite rain; null = can't tell.

guess.description: Rotation guess in season order, crop ids or 'bare'.

groundwater.description: Regional water-storage trend from GRACE/GRACE-FO (JPL mascon CRI RL06.3). Used in plans' water score.

trend_cm_per_year.description: Equivalent water thickness trend, cm per year.

shift_days_low.description: Lower end of shift_days' 95% range (Sen's slope range x (years - 1)).

shift_source.description: Where shift_days comes from (owner, 2026-11-14: DHM's official monsoon onset record).

shift_note.description: Plain words on whether the rains moved, English and Nepali.

monsoon_start.description: Owner, 2026-11-14: when the monsoon usually starts, from DHM's onset dates (entry into eastern Nepal; Kathmandu a few days later). usual_from/to = the middle half of the years (25th-75th percentile); late = strictly after late_after.

plans.description: At least three strategies, one of them the current rotation (NASA challenge objective).

period.description: The years the climate change is computed for (e.g. 2026-2040); `years` holds the period's last year.

models.description: The NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 climate models behind the range.

scenarios.description: The emission scenarios behind the range (e.g. ssp245, ssp585).

words.description: Plain words on what the range means, English and Nepali.

future.description: The 2040 outlook; null while it is not computed yet (build step 9; the block is then named in `mock`): show 'not ready yet', never a number.

method.description: Numbers for the site's method page (owner's go, 2026-11-13). Words come from pipeline/words at step 7.

season_detection.description: The three-way season-detection comparison (CLAUDE.md 'Field diary'; VALIDATION 3.15). null: it could not run, no HLS year had enough clear images (rules.yaml season_detection.no_dense_years; owner's item 3, 2026-11-14). No field-observed calendar exists, so scores show robustness to sparse data, not accuracy.

margin.description: A method replaces the threshold method only if its mean score beats it by at least this; fixed before the test.

thin_days.description: In a held-out year, one clear image kept per this many days.

rule_methods_agree.description: Share of days in the held-out years on which the threshold and change-point methods agree on all images: the reference days.

si.description: true for the SI (AI) season detective.

score.description: Mean share of reference days labelled the same from the thinned year.

start_diff_days.description: Median days between this method's and the threshold method's season dates (null for the threshold method itself).

peak_diff_days.description: Median days between this method's and the threshold method's season dates (null for the threshold method itself).

end_diff_days.description: Median days between this method's and the threshold method's season dates (null for the threshold method itself).

rain_correction.description: The GPM break correction for the method page (owner's decision 1, 2026-11-13; VALIDATION 3.9b). IMERG Final days from `from` are scaled month by month back to GPM's own level over reference_years. words: the plain-word explanation, English and Nepali.

factors.description: Multiplier of each calendar month's rain from `from` on.

held_out.description: Test against the Kathmandu Airport station's complete months on years not used to fit the factors: mean monthly error and total over the station's total, before and after.

rain_mm_per_year.description: Mean yearly rain in the field's GPM cell: over reference_years, and from `from` on as published and corrected; station_normal = DHM's 1991-2020 normal at Bhaktapur.

gauges.description: IMERG's monthly gauge weight in the cells around the field (range of yearly means) and GPCC stations a month in the field's 1-degree box, before and after `from`.

choices.description: Our stated choices that no published source fixes, for the method page (owner, 2026-11-13: keep them listed there). English, technical: the method page is for readers who want the details.

field_memory.description: Field memory (SI; build step 7b; owner, 2026-11-13): a small learned correction that predicts each season's peak greenness (NDVI, a stand-in for harvest) from the twin's stress and the weather, tested on years it had not seen (leave one year out). It is used only if it beats the physics twin alone AND 'no anomaly'; the result is shown either way. Optional.

kept.description: true = it won its test and is used; false = left out (physics only).

error.description: Held-out root-mean-square error of the predicted peak-NDVI anomaly (NDVI units; lower is better).

onset.description: The method page's monsoon-start paragraph (owner, 2026-11-14): two satellite-rain methods tested and why they cannot show a trend; DHM's official record used instead.

mock.description: Blocks that are NOT computed yet (owner, 2026-11-13). They hold no numbers: sections are grey with null wetness and temp and sure 0; future is null. The site shows 'not ready yet' for each block named here. Absent or empty when everything is real.

weather.description: Optional (owner, 2026-11-14 evening): Weather ahead, what usually happened on this field in each approximate Bikram Sambat month of its 24-year record, never a forecast (rules.yaml weather_ahead). Absent on fields outside Nepal.

key.description: The Gregorian month the block starts in (words.json months: 'Nov' = Mangsir, about 15 Nov to 14 Dec).

dangers.description: Ranked: most years first (rules.yaml weather_ahead.rank). The watered list is this one without kind dry_spell.

current_options.description: Owner, 2026-11-13: where the satellite cannot tell two rotations apart, the site asks the farmer which one is grown and switches between these saved results (no simulation in the browser). The default option is what plans[0] (id current) and replay.current hold. On the farmer's answer: show the option's crops, score, tabs, tips and replay as the current plan, and for each suggested plan the tabs in the option's `compared`. Optional: absent when the rotation is known.

id.description: The option's crops joined by '_', e.g. rice_potato.

score_dhm_rain.description: The plan's scores with GPM's rain as published, without the 2017 correction (owner's decision 1, 2026-11-13). Present only when a score differs; show score and this as a range.

tabs_ne.description: Nepali version of tabs, the same five tabs (owner, 2026-11-12). Nepali is shown first on the site.

tips_ne.description: Nepali version of tips: one per English tip, in the same order (validate.py checks the count).

replay.description: This option's replay, in the shape of replay.current.

tabs_ne.description: Nepali version of tabs, the same five tabs (owner, 2026-11-12). Nepali is shown first on the site.

compared.description: For each suggested plan id: its five tabs when it is compared with THIS current plan (the gains and the crops that are new differ). Its score, crops, tips and replay do not change.

future.description: Build step 9 (2026-11-14): this plan's harvest under the future climate, one value per entry in future.years; harvest_low/high = the spread across climate models and scenarios. For this current-plan option.

score_untuned_rain.description: The same as `score_dhm_rain` for the break-corrected rain without the gauge factors (owner, 2026-11-14 afternoon: the central rain is gauge-tuned; the other versions are the range). Present only where it differs; show the min and max over the central value and every alternative as the range.

future_untuned_rain.description: The same as `future_dhm_rain` for the break-corrected rain without the gauge factors (owner, 2026-11-14 afternoon: the central rain is gauge-tuned; the other versions are the range). Present only where it differs; show the min and max over the central value and every alternative as the range.

lonlat.description: [lon, lat] in degrees. Note the order: Leaflet wants [lat, lon].

polygon.description: Corner points, ring not closed (as in the CLAUDE.md example).

wetness.description: Soil wetness 0 to 100; null while the sections are not computed yet (the block is then named in `mock`): show 'not ready yet'.

temp.description: Soil temperature from the probe, deg C (owner, 2026-11-12); null until the probe has read this section (show 'not sure yet'). Bounds from CLAUDE.md golden rule 12

low_ground.description: Build step 8 (2026-11-14): true when this part lies lower than the land around it (NASADEM topographic position index; rules.yaml sections), where cold air can collect on still nights; null when not computed. Show a small 'low ground' mark, never colour alone.

greener.description: Build step 8 (2026-11-14): how this part's greenness usually compares with the rest of the field, from its own HLS 30 m pixels over the seasons (rules.yaml sections: a consistency test fixed in advance). 'unknown' = the satellite cannot tell.

heat.description: Hot days above the local 90th percentile of Tmax.

frost.description: risk = nights 0 to 2 C; high = nights below 0 C (CLAUDE.md 'Frost').

cover_sure.description: How sure the month's `cover` word is, 0 to 1 like a section's `sure` (owner, 2026-11-13): the share of days in the satellite years on which our two ways of reading the seasons, the rule (threshold) method and the SI season detective, give the same label. A lower number = less sure: show fog. Optional. It says where the two part ways, not how right either is.

tabs_ne.description: Nepali version of tabs, the same five tabs (owner, 2026-11-12). Nepali is shown first on the site.

tips_ne.description: Nepali version of tips: one per English tip, in the same order (validate.py checks the count).

score_dhm_rain.description: The plan's scores with GPM's rain as published, without the 2017 correction (owner's decision 1, 2026-11-13). Present only when a score differs; show score and this as a range.

future.description: Build step 9 (2026-11-14): this plan's harvest under the future climate, one value per entry in future.years; harvest_low/high = the spread across climate models and scenarios.

future_dhm_rain.description: The same outlook on GPM rain as published (no 2017 correction): show beside `future` as a range, like score_dhm_rain.

score_untuned_rain.description: The same as `score_dhm_rain` for the break-corrected rain without the gauge factors (owner, 2026-11-14 afternoon: the central rain is gauge-tuned; the other versions are the range). Present only where it differs; show the min and max over the central value and every alternative as the range.

future_untuned_rain.description: The same as `future_dhm_rain` for the break-corrected rain without the gauge factors (owner, 2026-11-14 afternoon: the central rain is gauge-tuned; the other versions are the range). Present only where it differs; show the min and max over the central value and every alternative as the range.

event.description: The year's weather event for the FIELD: the same on every plan (owner, 2026-11-13). drought = the monsoon's or the winter's rain in the lowest fifth of the record; flood = the calendar year's wettest day in the top fifth; drought goes first. No 'frost' (owner, 2026-11-12): frost is shown only as a risk band in diary.months[].frost.

event_season.description: Only with event 'drought', and only when the drought comes from one season (owner, 2026-11-13): 'winter' = a dry winter (December to February), 'monsoon' = a dry monsoon (June to September). Absent when both seasons were dry, and for every other event.

irrigated.description: The same year with irrigation whenever the root zone passes the stress point (owner's go, 2026-11-12). harvest and dry_days above are the field's own water case.

dhm_rain.description: The same year run with GPM's rain as published, without the 2017 correction (owner's decision 1, 2026-11-13: the rain gauges behind NASA's correction stopped reporting around this field in January 2017). Present only in years where it changes harvest, dry_days, event or the irrigated case; the year's own values use the corrected rain. Show the two as a range (e.g. a basket from the lower to the higher harvest).

event_season.description: Only with event 'drought', and only when the drought comes from one season (owner, 2026-11-13): 'winter' = a dry winter (December to February), 'monsoon' = a dry monsoon (June to September). Absent when both seasons were dry, and for every other event.

untuned_rain.description: The same as `dhm_rain` for the break-corrected rain without the gauge factors (owner, 2026-11-14 afternoon: the central rain is gauge-tuned; the other versions are the range). Present only where it differs; show the min and max over the central value and every alternative as the range.

event_season.description: Only with event 'drought', and only when the drought comes from one season (owner, 2026-11-13): 'winter' = a dry winter (December to February), 'monsoon' = a dry monsoon (June to September). Absent when both seasons were dry, and for every other event.

future_series.description: One value per entry in future.years. harvest_low/high = spread across models and scenarios.

type.description: Golden rule 8: model-based data must be labelled model.
